songs.title: ATM
songs.verdict: A woozy, off-kilter Atlanta melodic rap cut in the Sahbabii and melodic-Thug tradition of slippery, unpredictable flows.
songs.body: Rroxket is a Georgia rapper The FADER has followed since his 2024 self-titled tape; HariRoc produces. The song pairs hazy melodic delivery with offbeat flows and comes from his latest project, High School Flunky.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (ATL melodic/alt-rap). FADER Songs You Need, Nov 11 2026 (https://www.thefader.com/2026/11/11/songs-you-need-in-your-life-this-week-november-11-2026); YouTube link converted from the article's embed. FADER calls High School Flunky his latest release but gives no date, so confirm it's inside the window. Listener count unknown, likely well under 100k.

songs.title: Sow Pain into Rapture (feat. Fatboi Sharif & Amani Fela)
songs.verdict: Eerie, industrial-drummed abstract rap that hands Fatboi Sharif's metallic, otherworldly voice a cavernous stage.
songs.body: MOWRI is a Brooklyn producer, percussionist and sound designer; Fatboi Sharif raps and Amani Fela co-composed. The track goes for a haunted, cavernous mood with a jittery rhythm.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (abstract/experimental underground, Fatboi Sharif orbit). Buffablog, Oct 29 2026 (https://buffablog.com/mowri-sow-pain-into-rapture/); Spotify link converted from the article's embed, IG handle from the article. Release date assumed from post date. Very small artist.

songs.title: Dead
songs.verdict: Orchestral boom bap with staccato strings, woodwinds and scratches under two verses staring down mortality.
songs.body: Maffmatix and Charlton Banks are two rising underground MCs. Maffmatix's verse is about regret and missed chances; Banks's treats death as a constant street threat, over a big string-and-scratch beat.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (boom bap). Buffablog, Oct 21 2026 (https://buffablog.com/maffmatix-and-charlton-banks-dead/); Spotify link converted from the article's embed. No exact release date in the article, so confirm it's inside the window. Charlton Banks's IG per the article: charlton_banks_og. Very small.

songs.title: BLAIR WITCH
songs.verdict: A horror-movie-themed French single that throws terror plugg, rage and hardcore trap into one menacing pile-up.
songs.body: Sherifflazone is a French underground rapper working in rage and terror plugg. This Nov 4 single leans into menacing hardcore-trap energy and comes with a music video.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (French rage/terror plugg). idontknowerik Weekly Wrap Up Nov 2-8 2026 (https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-nov-2nd-2026-nov-8th), released Nov 4; all three links copied from that post (Spotify is the single's release page). Listener count unknown, likely small.

songs.title: The Clean Up Crew - Volume 1
songs.verdict: A gritty Philly drill tape with a cloud-rap haze, rolled out alongside a stack of DIY music videos.
songs.body: HappyDranker is a Philadelphia drill rapper who dropped this mixtape on Nov 8. It stays in raw Philly drill territory with hazy cloud-rap shading.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (Philly drill). idontknowerik Weekly Wrap Up Nov 2-8 2026 (https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-nov-2nd-2026-nov-8th); SoundCloud set link copied from that post. Spotify/YouTube are struck through there, so it may be SoundCloud-only. The post also lists a video for the track 'Blatt Mafia' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n7rzF3AqO5Y) if you'd rather weigh one song. Very underground.

songs.title: Shing (feat. Toxic Lyrikali)
songs.verdict: A gritty Kenyan street-rap single riding an afro trap and dancehall bounce.
songs.body: Kapitani is a Kenyan underground rapper; the feature is Nairobi's Toxic Lyrikali. The song mixes afro trap and dancehall rhythm with raw street delivery.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (international underground). idontknowerik Weekly Wrap Up Oct 19-25 2026 (https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-19th-2026-oct), released Oct 12; links copied from that post. Toxic Lyrikali has a Kenyan following, so check the combined reach.

songs.title: Cloud Nine
songs.verdict: A hyperpop breakup song that drives distorted synths into live pop-punk guitars on the way to a big chorus.
songs.body: Boy Sim is an LA producer and songwriter who produced Slayyyter's "Hello Kitty" and "Touch My Body" and has opened for her on tour. The single is about acting over a breakup when you aren't, and previews his upcoming record.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane. Released Oct 9 2026 (BroadwayWorld); EARMILK covered it Nov 5 (https://earmilk.com/2026/11/05/boy-sim-finds-an-uncomfortable-kind-of-happiness-on-euphoric-single-cloud-nine/), Spotify and YouTube links from its embeds. Soundcharts shows about 11K monthly listeners. No current label named. IG not confirmed from an official source.

songs.title: Ciao
songs.verdict: A short, glitchy cross-pop EP that splices breakbeats, hyperpop gloss, 90s shoegaze haze and Auto-Tuned vocals.
songs.body: miaw is a Copenhagen duo, Liza Dries and Frederik Fog, whose earlier singles came out on purr records. The five tracks run about 16 minutes, moving from ambient and sample-heavy to drum'n'bass and downtempo.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane. EARMILK EP review, Oct 23 2026 (https://earmilk.com/2026/10/23/miaw-ciao-ep-review/); Spotify link from its embed. Review says 'recently released' with no exact date, so check it's after mid-Sept. Festival-circuit act (Roskilde, ESNS, by:Larm); listener count unknown, probably small.

songs.title: We Can Rot Together
songs.verdict: A dancefloor album of mutated house, trance and techno shot through with cybernetic digital hardcore and jokes about internet overload.
songs.body: Kill Alters is Bonnie Baxter's project, and this is her third album on the indie label Hausu Mountain. She built it in an iOS app from synths, drums and her own sampled voice, chasing 90s-to-Y2K rave energy.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop-adjacent lane (glitch/digital hardcore edge). Released Oct 16 2026 on Hausu Mountain; Apple link and date confirmed on Apple's artist page. Listed in idontknowerik's Oct 12-18 wrap-up (https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-12th-2026-oct). Bandcamp/Spotify left empty (not verified). Small indie act; check listeners.

songs.title: Take It All Back
songs.verdict: Early-2010s complextro nostalgia pushed toward hyperpop, with dreamy female vocals and a drum'n'bass lift.
songs.body: TATE SEDAR is an electronic producer whose debut EP was called THIS IS POST-EDM; this single is on Big Fish Recordings. It revisits electro-house textures and pushes them toward hyperpop.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane, weakest fit (more electro house than scene hyperpop). Released Oct 30 2026 per EARMILK (https://earmilk.com/2026/10/30/tate-sedar-blends-electro-house-memories-and-hyperpop-energy-on-take-it-all-back/); Spotify link from its embed. Listener count unknown.

songs.title: iD
songs.verdict: An Argentine digicore/hyperpop release, the kind of glitchy, pitched-up bedroom rush the SoundCloud scene runs on.
songs.body: Evar is an Argentine artist working in digicore and hyperpop. iD came out Nov 6 2026.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop/digicore lane. idontknowerik Weekly Wrap Up Nov 2-8 2026 (https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-nov-2nd-2026-nov-8th), tagged hyperpop/digicore, released Nov 6; both links copied from that post. Spotify link is a release page; check whether iD is a single or a short project and adjust 'kind'. Little else known, so the verdict is deliberately generic. Likely very small.

songs.title: FINITE.
songs.verdict: A grief-heavy shoegaze record that leans on fuzzed-out 90s alt-rock and grunge weight rather than pure haze.
songs.body: Sky Is Alright is a London/Los Angeles shoegaze band led by songwriter Rishi Neal Arora with drummer Chris Gregory. FINITE. is their first full-length in five years, written after the death of Arora's sister.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane (shoegaze/grunge). Obscure Sound, Nov 5 2026 (https://www.obscuresound.com/2026/11/sky-is-alright-finite/); Spotify link from the album embed. 2021 debut was on Somewherecold Records. Listener count unknown, very likely small. Confirm exact release date.

songs.title: While It Lasts
songs.verdict: Gentle dream pop built on shimmering guitar and airy vocals, keeping the drums politely in the background.
songs.body: Field Season is an East Bay duo: vocalist Nadya Ali, also a conservation scientist, and guitarist-producer Matt Lavin. "While It Lasts" aims for a soft, glowing dream-pop feel.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane (dream pop/bedroom-adjacent). Obscure Sound, Nov 3 2026 (https://www.obscuresound.com/2026/11/field-season-while-it-lasts/); Spotify link from the track embed. Very small act, no label mentioned. Check listeners and exact release date.

songs.title: Bitter End
songs.verdict: Hazy sibling harmonies drift over a mellow bassline in an intimate dream-pop song with a light shoegaze blur.
songs.body: ANGLES is a bi-coastal project from New York songwriter and bassist Preston DeGarmo and his sister Rylie DeGarmo. "Bitter End" comes from their debut album Dream for Me and favors close, dreamy atmosphere over noise.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane. Obscure Sound, Oct 23 2026 (https://www.obscuresound.com/2026/10/angles-bitter-end/); Spotify track from the embed (album: https://open.spotify.com/album/7BexAR1gg3Cf52ud4OdjBx). Debut-album act, likely tiny. Only the post date is known; confirm release date.

songs.title: Stillwater
songs.verdict: A stripped-back piano ballad from a songwriter quietly shaping other people's records, with a chorus built to land hard.
songs.body: Threshold is the solo project of Isaac Eiger, former frontman of New York indie band Strange Ranger, who has since written for Chanel Beads, Frost Children and ADELA. "Stillwater" is a piano-led ballad on untitled (recs), with a video by Daniel Patrick Brennan.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane. Out around Oct 20 2026 on untitled (recs). FADER Songs You Need Oct 21 (https://www.thefader.com/2026/10/21/songs-you-need-in-your-life-october-21-2026) and Stereogum (https://stereogum.com/2515201/threshold-stillwater/music); YouTube from those embeds. Listener count unknown, probably modest.

songs.title: Stratocaster
songs.verdict: Bright, chirpy twee pop about rockstar daydreams with a quiet ache about fitting in underneath.
songs.body: Worldpeace DMT is the London duo of Leo Fincham and Rowan Miles, moving from the laptop twee of their 2025 debut toward live-band arrangements. "Stratocaster" is from their second LP, Stick Around For Tea, a concept album about childhood.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane. Album out around Oct 16 2026. FADER Songs You Need Oct 21 (YouTube from that embed) and Stereogum (https://stereogum.com/2514847/worldpeace-dmts-stick-around-for-tea-is-not-your-fathers-laptop-twee/music; Bandcamp from there). Buzziest indie pick (FADER reported a 20-date US tour), so check monthly listeners are under 100k.

songs.title: HOLD THE LIGHT
songs.verdict: An unapologetically bright R&B love song that bets on joy over brooding, with a wink toward the Whitney era.
songs.body: Parisalexa (Paris Williams) is a Seattle-rooted R&B singer, producer and engineer who has written for Normani, Alicia Keys and Chloe x Halle. She co-produced this follow-up to "Honeymoon" with RJ Parker, built on the rush of new love.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Rated R&B Essential New R&B Releases, Oct 9 2026 (https://ratedrnb.com/2026/10/new-releases-dawn-richard-danielle-ponder-joyce-wrice/); Spotify from the embed. Appears independent (no major deal), but CHECK LISTENER COUNT: active since ~2018, may be near or over 100k.

songs.title: Only You
songs.verdict: A hushed, inward-looking alt-R&B track that turns gratitude into its whole mood.
songs.body: Carl Kammeyer is an emerging artist who wrote and produced this single himself. It's a meditative, close-mic thank-you to the people who carry you through hard stretches.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. EARMILK, Oct 28 2026, filed under alt-R&B (https://earmilk.com/2026/10/28/carl-kammeyer-celebrates-the-power-of-gratitude-on-new-single-only-you/); Spotify and YouTube from its embeds, IG is the one EARMILK links (not confirmed on his own profiles). Looks very small; check listeners.

songs.title: Roll With Me Tonight
songs.verdict: A Motown-leaning slow build where a pulsing bassline and swelling strings tee up a big, soul-forward vocal.
songs.body: Macy O is a soul-pop singer from Shropshire, England, raised on soul and Motown. This single previews her upcoming EP Soul Searching and is about the thrill and nerves of a new romance.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane (soul-pop, a stretch). Atwood Magazine Weekly Roundup, Oct 30 2026 (https://atwoodmagazine.com/wr-roundup-2026-10-30/); YouTube from its embed, but play it to confirm it's this song. Release date not stated; check it's after mid-Sept. Very small, appears unsigned.

songs.title: spiritual warfare
songs.verdict: An unsettling ambient collage that sets a Malcolm X speech against strings and reeds, closer to sound art than song.
songs.body: Klein is a London multi-instrumentalist known for collage-heavy experimental and ambient records. The track is from her album my own fairytale (Sept 28 2026), built on field recordings and sound collage.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane. FADER Songs You Need, Sept 30 2026 (https://www.thefader.com/2026/09/30/songs-you-need-in-your-life-september-30-2026); YouTube from its embed. Album also in idontknowerik's Sept 21-27 wrap-up, which lists Spotify https://open.spotify.com/album/6hN2H5hvPrYLrG3zYfwvSE and Bandcamp https://klein1997.bandcamp.com/album/my-own-fairytale/ (not put in fields). Cult following, no major deal; check listeners under 100k. Near the edge of the 60-day window.
